subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

A Prime Minister of India / will address / the nation today / on the occasion of Independence Day.

options.text: on the occasion of Independence Day

solution:
The correct answer is** 'A Prime Minister of India'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The segment that contains a grammatical error is: **A Prime Minister of India.**
 
• The error lies in the use of the** indefinite article "A" before "Prime Minister of India."**
 
• In this context, ***"Prime Minister of India" ***refers to **a specific position held by one individual at a time**, so the **definite article "the" should be used instead of "A." **

 

**Correct Sentence:__** ***The Prime Minister of India **will address the nation today on the occasion of Independence Day.*
